events.title: polymorphite - PGD 1.2.1 Update Notice
events.summary: The demo has been updated to version PGD 1.2.1. This version fixes some bugs, largely related to Transit Mode.Additions- Characters can now be OVERCLOCKED with Concepts.Changes- "Double" effect cards in Transit Mode now stack additively (i.e. using 2 Double cards will cause the next tile to be 3x)Bugfixes- Fixed numerous bugs with tutorialization softlocking the game (attempted fix! If this doesn't work I'll try it again)- Fixed Expert Battles in Transit Mode not giving you better stats than Nor
